instanceMethods.comment: Sets the upper bound of the range dimension, otherwise resets it to an empty range with the specified upper bound.

instanceMethods.comment: Returns the lower bound of the range dimension, otherwise - zero.

instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the dimension is of +/- tolerance kind. Dimension is of +/- tolerance kind if its values array contains three elements defining the main value and the lower/upper tolerances.

instanceMethods.name: SetUpperTolValue
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the upper value of the toleranced dimension, otherwise resets a simple dimension to toleranced one with the specified lower/upper tolerances. Returns False in case of range dimension.

instanceMethods.name: SetLowerTolValue
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the lower value of the toleranced dimension, otherwise resets a simple dimension to toleranced one with the specified lower/upper tolerances. Returns False in case of range dimension.

instanceMethods.comment: Returns the lower value of the toleranced dimension, otherwise - zero.
